name: self-restart
description: Lets a session restart itself on Windows once the current turn ends: it opens a new terminal window in the folder the session started in, exits, and the new window resumes the same conversation (claude --resume) once the old process has gone, then can resume work on its own.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.
